name: Mary's | 200mg 10pk Transdermal Patch | Relax Indica
description: Transdermal patches are unique in the topical category because they are able to break the "blood-brain barrier", meaning you may experience psychoactive effects! Patches are great for long lasting, controlled relief and are intended to be left on the skin for 12-24 hours.
